findings.description: Validation harness uses API key authentication for all steps (POST and GET), but GET endpoint /auth/orgs/{org_id}/activity requires JWT authentication
findings.impact: Cannot validate end-to-end data flow with API key only. Dashboard integration cannot be tested via API key auth.
findings.rootCause: By design - specification supports both authentication methods for different endpoints (CLI uses API keys for POST, Dashboard uses JWT for GET)
findings.recommendation: Update validation harness to support dual authentication (API key for POST, JWT for GET) or create separate test with JWT token generation
